d: Platinum white hair is styled with long, sweeping bangs and gathered into two high, voluminous side-tails secured by dark olive-green ribbons. The eyes are a pale sky-blue with a calm, gentle expression, set upon a youthful face with a soft, adolescent maturity. A slender build is dressed in a white Victorian-style blouse featuring a ruffled high collar, a small red bow at the neck, and a black strap crossing the shoulder, paired with a black fingerless glove on one hand.
